title: Peacock waits for the beat drop
storyboard: Film: creator lip-syncs the trending sound's build-up, hard cut on the drop to the peacock fanning

scenes.headline: Waiting for the beat to drop like...
That fan isn't his tail
scenes.body: The 'train' is long tail coverts. His real tail feathers are the stiff ones behind it, holding it up.

scenes.label: how fast a peacock rattles his tail against his train

caption:
He's been practising this drop all season.

High-speed video showed that the eyespot feathers in the train are in resonance at the same frequency as the rattle.

Source: Dakin et al. 2016, PLOS ONE.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Beat-drop trend cut to a real peacock display (Hyderabad); creator lip-syncs the sound in the opener, and the 'drop' lands on a sourced fact about the rattling frequency.
